The retro sneaker creators wear every single day.

adidas Handball Spezial is a retro low-top sneaker with a suede upper and gum sole, originally made for handball in 1979. Creators now wear it as an everyday casual shoe, mostly in the brown IF6490 colourway, styled with jeans and dark pants. It is sold on adidas.pl, adidas.it, adidas.nl and at sneaker retailers, also in beige, navy, leopard print and kids sizes.

Questions people ask before buying

The questions Google shows for this product, answered from what 530 creators actually said and showed in their stories.

Are adidas Handball Spezial still fashionable this season?

Yes, creators consistently treat them as a current trend, with quotes like 'the most fashionable sneaker on the market today' and 'fall must have'. The Classic Retro Appeal theme shows up in 73 of 220 stories read, showing the retro look keeps resonating with shoppers.

What size should I order for the Handball Spezial?

Several creators say the shoe runs small, with comments like 'you need to buy a bigger size' and 'not true to size, disappointing fit' among the reported negatives. Sizing advice sits inside the Comfortable Durable Build theme, found in 50 of 220 stories read, so most shoppers suggest ordering slightly larger than usual.

Are these sneakers comfortable for everyday wear?

Comfort is one of the most praised traits, with the Comfortable Durable Build theme appearing in 50 of 220 stories read and quotes calling them 'super comfortable' for everyday wear. A small number of reviewers noted the low heel style can feel less comfortable during long work shifts.

What color options are available for the Handball Spezial?

The brown IF6490 suede colourway is the most posted by far, but creators also show off navy, beige and leopard print pairs, matching the Print and Color Variety theme seen in 40 of 220 stories read. Kids sizes exist too, and the adult versions are sold on adidas.pl, adidas.it and adidas.nl.

How does the Handball Spezial compare to other adidas retro models like the Samba?

The creator evidence collected for this product does not directly compare it to the Samba or explain specific design differences between the two models. What the stories do confirm is that the Handball Spezial itself is loved for its 1979 handball heritage, suede upper and gum sole.

Can the Handball Spezial be styled for everyday outfits?

Yes, Versatile Everyday Style is the single biggest theme in the creator content, appearing in 91 of 220 stories read. Shoppers describe them as going 'with almost any casual outfit' and ideal for daily wear, especially paired with dark pants or casual autumn looks.
